inputs.text: A flat, straight-on screenshot of a complete modern website home page, shown full length as one tall scrolling page on a plain light grey background, like a polished design portfolio shot. From top to bottom: a slim navigation bar, a large hero section with a sunlit editorial photograph of a calm studio workspace and a bold headline area, a row of three rounded cards with soft shadows and small illustrations, a wide image band, a testimonial section, and a dark charcoal footer. Warm off-white background, sage green and terracotta accents, generous white space, 12 px rounded corners, thin hairline borders, clean geometric sans-serif type hierarchy. All text is shown only as soft grey placeholder lines, no readable words, no logos.
